correctness.rationale: Gram M=diag(alpha)+(2D+W)/6 is positive definite. Convexity of integrated nodal evaluation kernels reduces the L-infinity projector norm to vertices. The comparison resolvent B=diag(alpha)+(2D-W)/6 has positive inverse, |M^{-1}|<=B^{-1}, q=3B1-2alpha and gives norm<=3 with strictness from atoms, odd cycles, or bipartite edge sign cancellation. For bipartite G, SM S=B, so exact row value Lambda_v=3-2sum(alpha_i a_vi)-sum_e w_e a_vi a_vj/(a_vi+a_vj). The graded path recurrence yields endpoint limit 3-2^(4-n)/3 for fixed n, hence unattained sharp 3. Independently inverted rational weighted 3-vertex example with atoms, verifying all exact row deficits, but no finite sample replaces analytic proof.
